verdict.rationale: Notion's developer docs confirm that comments are a first-class workspace object: they can be read and created via the REST API, and webhooks fire on new comments. Nothing in the evidence shows comments can be anchored to specific text spans or images inside a page, so only the general commenting capability is evidenced. Missing for 10: documentation of inline comments anchored to selected text, comments on images/blocks, any UI-level description of inline commenting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
